trial_court: High Court of Orissa at Cuttack, TRP(C) No.235 of 2021
case_name: Manashi Sethi vs Bimal Kumra Behera & Ors.

parties.respondent_defendant: Bimal Kumra Behera & Ors. (husband and others)

facts_of_case: The wife filed a Section 9 application to take back her husband, who had initiated the same proceeding. The husband's counsel prayed for deletion of a condition in the order dated 23.08.2021.

legal_principles.principle: A criminal case will be instituted against the husband for filing a case with false intention and wasting valuable time of Court.
legal_principles.held: It is made clear that if after the wife files an affidavit showing her willingness to join with the husband and the husband declines to take the wife, a criminal case will be instituted against the husband for filing a case with false intention and wasting valuable time of Court.
cited_cases: Manashi Sethi vs Bimal Kumra Behera & Ors., (2021)

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the husband to take back the wife.
legal_principles.held: This Court also considering that there exists a Section 9 application at the instance of the husband, further recording the clear statement of the learned counsel for the wife that the wife involved is ready and willing to join the husband, consciously passed the order dated 23.08.2021
cited_cases: Manashi Sethi vs Bimal Kumra Behera & Ors., (2021)

outcome.final_order: The court observed that nothing prevents the husband from lodging an appropriate proceeding if the wife declines to join him, and directed the trial court to record the undertaking of the wife to withdraw her application if she agrees to join the husband.
